body.p: And now I will tell you a tale. A little tale. One, well, man is sitting on a seat. An unknown man. Oh, at some time, well, three women went, went to get the water. In both hands, well, they carry the buckets, these three women. They carry two buckets. The three women are walking, they are walking to an ice hole. The unknown man watches. Then they filled their buckets with water and went back. They want to go back. The ice hole is not far away. The women are talking to each other. One woman said. "Oh, my son, when he sings, he sings very well. His sings," - she said, well. "If he whistles, - she said, - he whistles, like a bird. She said, - and he sings like a bird," - she said. And another woman said. "And my son. Can walk on his hands. His legs are up top. That's how he walks, that's how my son walks," - she said. And the third woman is silent. She does not want to tell about her son, what can he do? That's what she said. They reached the ice hole. Well, they filled their buckets. They are walking with the water. Oh, at some time, well, three boys appeared. One boy walks first. He truly whistles, as it was said about him. Then, whistling, he began to sing like a bird. And another boy comes. His head ... his head is down below. And his hands, he walks on his hands. And his legs are up top. That's how he walks. And the third boy is silent. He walks, walks, well, silently. He came to his mother. He asked his mother for a bucket. Silently, he carried them. His mother walks without buckets. And these two women. Their children just left like that, the two boys. And these two women walk with buckets. They walk with the heavy buckets. And this unknown man said. Sitting on a stool, said. "And where are your sons?" "Well, they just left," - they said. These two women said: "Our sons," - they said. "As for me, I didn't see any sons. I only saw one son. A boy. He took, - he said, - his mother's buckets." This boy, well, he saw. "And I haven't seen any other boys." Well. I have finished the tale.
